items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Great, Clifford Brown had a great sound, man

ctx.x: How about some of the next generation, how about folks like Clifford Brown or Lee Morgan?

Great, Clifford Brown had a great sound, man, and he had a big sound, a big mouth piece too. He didn‘t have no high range or anything, but he would go up to a certain high, but he wasn‘t going up for them altissimo notes and things, that wasn‘t his thing, he didn‘t have to go up after that, but he had such a big pretty sound, he had a big mouth piece and practiced and kept his thing and he could move over that horn now, so you‘ve got to have chops to do that.
